title: Refrigeration Service Technician Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Commercial Refrigeration Service: verifies results and open follow-up.
description: Refrigeration Service Technician Sign-Off Form covers compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents. The refrigeration service coordinator records Commercial Refrigeration Service performed work, tests, limits, and acceptance. Refrigeration Service Technician Sign-Off Form keeps Commercial Refrigeration Service exceptions visible until the refrigeration service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Refrigeration Service Technician Sign-Off Form at walk-in, reach-in, display case, machine area, and affected product zone. Document compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents identity before Commercial Refrigeration Service begins. Compare compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents findings with stated Commercial Refrigeration Service criteria; route unresolved Commercial Refrigeration Service issues to qualified refrigeration supervisor. For Refrigeration Service Technician Sign-Off Form, confirm requirements for Commercial Refrigeration Service. Ask qualified refrigeration supervisor to review Commercial Refrigeration Service conditions beyond the refrigeration service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Completion parties and source record
sections.guidance: For Commercial Refrigeration Service, identify responsible parties, walk-in, reach-in, display case, machine area, and affected product zone, and the linked compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents source.

fields.label: Make, model, serial, refrigerant designation, and circuit
Required range, product status, and alarm history

sections.title: Completion checks and remaining limitations
sections.guidance: Capture Commercial Refrigeration Service facts for compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Commercial Refrigeration Service completion checks
items: Product and air temperature at defined points
Door, gasket, drain, fan, coil, and airflow condition
Compressor, condenser, control, and defrost indication
Visible tubing, oil residue, frost pattern, and leak concern
Alarm, sensor, setpoint, and monitoring response

sections.title: Verified outcome and customer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Resolve open Commercial Refrigeration Service conditions; have refrigeration service coordinator assign the next Commercial Refrigeration Service owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Limitations, open work, and retained evidence
items: Food or product disposition not assigned
System cannot maintain the required range
Product hold, release, or disposition record
blocks.guidance: Pause Commercial Refrigeration Service when temperature control, refrigerant integrity, product disposition, or alarm protection is unresolved. Retain the available Commercial Refrigeration Service proof and route unresolved compressor, evaporator, condenser, controls, case, and temperature-controlled contents scope to refrigeration service coordinator.
